frame: 1366x768 native client frame, title bar cropped; x,y from top-left; rect = [x, y, w, h]

regions.name: minimap.panel
regions.read: whole minimap window; anchor for 1a-1c; can be dragged or collapsed by the player

regions.name: minimap.title_bar
regions.read: minimize / maximize / WORLD buttons: detect collapsed state

regions.name: minimap.map_name
regions.read: OCR two lines: region name, map name -> map id via server metadata

regions.name: minimap.map
regions.read: dots by colour: yellow = self, red = other players, blue/green = portals and NPCs -> world position

regions.name: status.level
regions.read: OCR digits in the orange level badge

regions.name: status.class_name
regions.read: OCR two lines: job (top), character name (bottom); name also seeds own-name-tag search

regions.name: status.hp
regions.read: top row OCR 'cur/max'; bottom row red fill ratio of the bar (y 750..760)

regions.name: status.mp
regions.read: top row OCR 'cur/max'; bottom row blue fill ratio

regions.name: status.exp
regions.read: top row OCR total and percent; bottom row green fill ratio

regions.name: status.buttons
regions.read: CASH SHOP / MENU / SHORT CUT: ignore, layout anchor only

regions.name: chat.input_line
regions.read: latest chat line / input box; OCR only when the bot needs party chat

regions.name: chat.icons
regions.read: chat mode and shortcut icons: ignore

regions.name: quickslot
regions.read: 2 rows x 4 cells, 35 px pitch: skill icon, cooldown shade, item count digits

regions.name: buffs.row1
regions.read: active buff icons, 32 px, anchored at the right edge (first at x 1330) and growing leftward; icon pitch still to measure with two or more buffs

regions.name: buffs.row2
regions.read: second buff row expected when the first fills; verify

regions.name: exp_loot_log
regions.read: right-aligned log of EXP gained and items picked up; OCR to attribute exp and loot per kill

regions.name: chat.history
regions.read: expanded chat log; collapsed in this frame; ignore unless party chat is needed

regions.name: own_character
regions.read: found each frame by own name tag (white text on dark box); feet = tag top minus a fixed offset; camera-to-world anchor

regions.name: world.viewport
regions.read: the whole frame: detectors for mobs, drops, players, ladders run here with regions 1, 13, 14, 20, 21 and 22 masked out; the map shows down to the last row beside the bottom HUD

regions.name: hud.bottom
regions.read: chat bar, chat icons and status bar with its buttons (outline x 283..1082 from row 700, rounded corners), and the shadow the client draws around them: 4 columns either side (x 279..282, 1083..1086) and 5 rows above (695..699), measured on fx-combat-exact against the mosaic; masked as drawn, no padding

regions.name: window.corner_left
regions.read: the macOS window's rounded bottom-left corner: white and anti-aliased pixels, up to 12 wide on the last row; masked

regions.name: window.corner_right
regions.read: the macOS window's rounded bottom-right corner, as region 21; masked

regions.name: own_tag.search
regions.read: where the own name tag is learned (OCR) and searched: the rows above the chat bar, since the status bar shows the name too
